why: The engine fingerprint changed, so every limit adjudication is void until mechanically re-derived. This is that re-derivation, plus the first measurement of the open PR stack as a whole.

era.what_moved_the_era: the gen3 Trick patch was DROPPED after review falsified it against Showdown: it asserted Trick fails when the user holds no item, and Showdown succeeds. The real gen<=4 rule is itemKnockedOff.

the_headline_finding.claim: The three matcher tolerance changes split into #1025 are LOAD-BEARING for 141 rows. I had described them as unrelated collateral whose deletion was a legitimate outcome. That was wrong.
the_headline_finding.mechanism: whether a heal caps depends on the damage roll, so cap membership makes the roll-scaled list's LENGTH roll-dependent, and the comparison rejects on length before any tolerance applies. Two engine arms differing only by a legal roll then read as structurally different.
the_headline_finding.but_they_are_still_not_correct: the same code fixes length by moving deterministic heals into the 9% magnitude window, so a 2 HP gen3 heal discrepancy -- exactly the rounding class this program exists to find -- now matches. Promote for LENGTH, compare exactly for MAGNITUDE. The two problems are separable and this code conflates them.

certification_verdict.single_shape: SUPERSEDED BY c84 -- the uniform basis string is the classifier's fall-through text, not a mechanism. The 8 rows are four or more shapes.

honest_reading.note: the gate counts 8 because it treats a family LABEL as an explanation. reports/c68 buckets LS_capped_lethal_shape, I2, I3 and I5 as candidate-not-finding -- no decisive signature.

what_the_era_change_did_to_the_residue.answer: nothing measurable. Attribution is row-for-row identical to C82: same 8 unattributed, same 28 candidate-not-finding, same 25 limits. (The earlier wording 'same single shape' is retracted by c84 -- the count is identical, the 'single shape' reading was wrong.)
what_the_era_change_did_to_the_residue.interpretation: the work in this PR stack was correctness work -- soundness of the cascade predicate, regression pins, provenance bindings, a falsified engine patch removed. None of it was residue reduction, and the measurement says so plainly rather than crediting it with an improvement it did not produce.

reproduce: merge the open splits, scripts/build_search_crate_engine.sh, then scripts/engine_transition_differential.py --games 200 --seed-start 19000000 --keep-repro 100000 --repros-per-game 100000
